rpc: Correct OpenRPC default metadata

Correct six argument metadata entries that produce misleading or invalid
OpenRPC defaults.

The getdeploymentinfo blockhash fallback and four sighashtype fallbacks
describe how omitted arguments are resolved. They are not literal values
accepted by the RPCs, so mark them as DefaultHint values.

The send include_watching option is boolean, but its string default makes
the generated schema internally inconsistent. Use a boolean value,
matching the analogous sendall option.

Runtime behavior is unchanged.

Github-Pull: #36297

canonical string for each comparison. This can be sped up by holding the
canonical string in memory, computed upon construction of

so that the comparison operates over the hash of the canonical string.

ci: use POSIX threads in Nix Windows cross shell

Guix release binaries use the POSIX GCC thread model, but the pinned
Nixpkgs cross compiler defaults to MCF. Select POSIX through the
Nixpkgs threads hook so GCC and its target libraries agree.

Leave threads.package null because making winpthreads a target
dependency exposes its headers to native GCC build tools. Supply its
headers and libraries through EXTRA_*_FOR_TARGET for target libraries
instead.

Add winpthreads to the compiler wrapper so builds in the shell get
its include and library paths without manual NIX_CFLAGS_COMPILE or
NIX_LDFLAGS exports.

Github-Pull: #36316
